name: features.live_delta
description: Streaming: features updated after a given timestamp
querySql: SELECT f.id, f.external_id, f.source_id, f.source_table, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geometry)::jsonb AS geometry, f.attributes, f.updated_at FROM tessera.geo_features f WHERE f.updated_at > :since AND f.source_id = COALESCE(:sourceId::uuid, f.source_id) ORDER BY f.updated_at ASC
